characterization_status: complete: 149 source-recorded cases, including nested asset URL omissions/null IDs

database_effects: api_tokens.last_used for valid API key; no domain row writes

source_branches.when: no API key, invalid/expired/inactive token or inactive user
source_branches.observable: Missing key returns 401, invalid credentials return 403. Valid key updates api_tokens.last_used before permission checks. Sessions do not authenticate this API.

source_branches.when: active project member including guest, independent of workspace membership
source_branches.observable: Safe method authorization checks live active ProjectMember scoped to requester/project/workspace slug; no role threshold. Missing, deleted or inactive project membership and cross-tenant slug deny 403. Related project deletion/archival does not itself deny permission.

source_branches.when: request carrying any nonempty API key reaches audit middleware, including credential rejection or 405
source_branches.observable: One durable Celery process_logs task on the default empty exchange with celery routing key, delivery_mode 2. Payload contains HMAC token identifier, redacted request headers, exact query string/path/method/body/status/serialized response. No worker runs; no audit row is inserted during request. Anonymous request and CORS short-circuit enqueue nothing.

source_branches.when: HEAD or ordinary OPTIONS with valid key/member
source_branches.observable: 405 because URL as_view explicitly excludes both; authentication, last_used and audit still execute. Allow preserves original mixed methods. CORS preflight short-circuits before authentication/audit.

source_branches.when: fields and expand used on dynamic serializers
source_branches.observable: Comma-separated exact untrimmed tokens. Unknown selected fields disappear; empty selection behaves as all. Expansion only acts on selected declared fields. Known relation names expand to API lite/full serializers, even null relations; other fields use <name>_id or null. Write-only declared fields can reappear via expand. Metadata JSON remains opaque.

Live modules scoped by project and workspace slug. No explicit live Project lookup. List/detail exclude archived modules; archived list requires archived_at. Total counts distinct live ModuleIssue IDs with issue archived_at null and not draft; group metrics count DISTINCT state.group, hence 0 or 1. Issue deleted_at is not filtered in aggregate joins. No member multiplication. User order_by ignored, fixed -created_at.

Exact field tokens precede expansion; members is unconditionally re-added afterward, including fields=unknown. Members includes duplicate and soft-deleted through rows, ordered by user -created_at, including inactive users. Lead expansion remains scalar lead_id. JSON metadata is opaque; start_date/target_date are date-only. Lite ignores fields/expand and has no metrics.

Missing/deleted/archived module does not raise or hide links. IssueManager excludes deleted/archived/draft/triage issues and archived project. Assignee/label ordering introduces duplicate rows, preserving base total_count. issue_module__module__name reuses the filtered module JOIN, so it does not introduce other-module rows or duplicates. All fourteen issue sorts supported; other filters/grouping ignored.

Shared source BasePaginator default/max1000; invalid values and zero/negative observed. Forward/backward cursor. Detail ignores pagination. Lite supports ±created_at,updated_at,name,start_date,target_date,status,sort_order; invalid falls back -created_at.

For GET/HEAD/OPTIONS, use_read_replica=True routes token lookup, project permission and domain/queryset reads to the configured read replica. APIToken.last_used writes route to primary. Match existing apiKeyValidator=NewWithReaderWriter(activityReadsPool,pool), not the identity primary-only validator. Non-read unsupported methods use primary protocol authorization. Durable API audit publishes after response without running a worker.

Attachment/description asset URLs stringify nullable project/issue IDs as None. Missing asset workspace omits avatar_url/cover_image_url entirely; an unknown entity type emits explicit null. Expanded issue assignees use the same UserLite serializer.

shared_transport_evidence: Existing API-key activity reads cover common authentication/rate-limit/timezone/middleware behavior. This family records exact Allow and explicit absence of HEAD/OPTIONS handlers, plus real durable API audit envelopes for every source request.
reuse_analysis: Extend internal/modulereads repository ownership. Existing app endpoints use different serializers/permissions/annotation and archival contracts; do not reuse their final JSON or app pagination blindly.
tie_order_normalization: Only adjacent equal-key groups on already-selected pages: lite dates/status, issues archived_at/priority/state IDs and target-module ordering. Never normalize distinct keys or repaginate. Module-name issue ordering reuses the filtered target module so all keys tie.
